caption: Fig A – New L2: Matched octree leaf cells (blue=coarse 1×1, yellow=refined 0.5×0.5) over mesh. Morton curve (orange) threads leaf-cell centroids. Red = multi-cell assigned element at boundary.
description: Octree cells matched to mesh intrinsic structure. Leaf cells hold ~2 triangles each. Morton Z-order curve connects cell centroids for fast lookup. One boundary element is highlighted as multi-cell assigned.
